news.title: Marten de Roon reflects on failed World Cup: ‘Ronald Koeman knows that himself too’
news.lede: Marten de Roon reflects on the Netherlands' World Cup exit on Kick 't met from Ziggo Sport. The midfielder also discusses the fierce criticism of then national team coach Ronald Koeman.On the criticism of Koeman after the round-of-32 defeat to Morocco, De Roon says: "It's a shame, but it's part of the game." "And Koeman himself knows that too."" When things go well, people look to the manager or the star players," the AS Roma veteran continues.

news.title: Top four teams in Fifa rankings set to be kept apart until semi-finals at 2027 Women’s World Cup
news.lede: Team must win World Cup group to trigger rule. Spain, US, Germany and England currently in top four. The top four ranked teams will be separated until the semi-finals at the 2027 Women’s World Cup, ­provided they each win their group, after a change to the tournament’s draw procedure was confirmed by Fifa. Spain, USA, Germany and England are ranked one to four in the world respectively, although USA and England still need to qualify for the tournament.

news.title: Flamingos: Breakdown of Tinubu’s ₦100m rewards after U-17 World Cup win
news.lede: Published on 11 Nov 2026 at 21:26 by Adefolahan Guerreiro. Nigeria’s Flamingos have received a huge financial reward following their historic triumph at the 2026 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup, with President Bola Tinubu approving different incentives for the players and coaching staff. First Lady Oluremi Tinubu announced the packages earlier today, during a reception for the world champions at the State House in Abuja, where she represented the President. The rewards include ₦100 million for every player, ₦100 million for head coach Akeem Busari and ₦50 million for each member of the technical crew.

news.title: Harry Kane confirms 2030 World Cup plans and doesn't rule out future Premier League return
news.lede: The England captain and Ballon d'Or winner joined talkSPORT Drive for an exclusive interview, and he was asked a variety of questions by Andy Goldstein and Darren Bent in a brilliant, wide-ranging chat. He recently put pen to paper on a new contract with Bayern Munich that lasts until the summer of 2029. Kane said he doesn't believe this will be the final contract of his football career, although he doesn't have any intention of cutting short his agreement with his current club. The England legend is very happy in Germany, but once that deal expires, he's not sure what will happen.

news.title: Decisive phase in the 2030 World Cup final file: FIFA delegation evaluates the Bernabeu before visiting Morocco
news.lede: The file concerning the dispute between Morocco and Spain over hosting the final match of the 2030 World Cup is witnessing major developments these days, amid anticipation of FIFA's decision regarding the winner of this honour.According to the newspaper " AS ", FIFA continued their tour of the cities bidding to host the 2030 World Cup on Wednesday, stopping in Zaragoza.The international federation's technical staff inspected progress at the La Romareda stadium. The project is running slightly behind schedule, but it should be finished by FIFA's 2029 deadline.FIFA will confirm the final selection of host cities in the second quarter of 2027. The federation's elections fall on 18 March 2027 in Morocco, and no decision is expected before then.After Zaragoza, the delegation head to Madrid, where Rafael Louzán, president of the Royal Spanish Football Federation, will receive them.

news.title: Football: Soccer-FIFA clears joint bids for 2031 and 2035 Women's World Cups
news.lede: Nov 11 (Reuters) - Two ⁠joint bids for the Women's World ⁠Cup in 2031 and 2035 have met ‌the minimum hosting requirements and will be submitted to the Extraordinary FIFACongress for approval, world soccer's governing body ​FIFA said on Wednesday. * The ⁠2031 bid is a ⁠joint submission from the United States, Mexico, Costa ⁠Rica ‌and Jamaica, which proposed 20 stadiums in 20 host cities, receiving an ⁠overall score of 4.4 out of 5. * ​The 2035 ‌joint bid from England, Northern Ireland, Scotland ⁠and ​Wales proposed 19 stadiums in 15 host cities and received an overall score of 4.3 out ⁠of 5. * The 2031 edition ​will have 48 teams taking part for the first time, with the 2035 edition also maintaining ⁠the same format with 12 groups of four teams each, followed by a knockout round that begins with the last 32.

news.title: It’s crucial Banyana qualify for World Cup, says midfield fulcrum Motlhalo
news.lede: Banyana Banyana midfield fulcrum Linda Motlhalo knows what to expect from Chinese Taipei, Uzbekistan and Ecuador during the Fifa Women’s World Cup Play-Off Tournament in Morocco. The play-offs take place from November 28 to December 5 at the Mohammed VI Football Complex in Rabat and Football Academy Mohammed VI in Salé with the final phase scheduled for February next year. Banyana are at this stage because they missed out on automatic qualification for the showpiece in Brazil next year after failing to reach the semifinals of the 2026 Women’s Africa Cup of Nations (Wafcon). Speaking to www.Fifa.com, Motlhalo said Asian sides Chinese Taipei and Uzbekistan like to play with the ball and she expects Ecuador to be physical.
